name: Limes
source:
A mysterious girl. 
She seems to have emotions but lacks expressiveness.

Likes: Nothing notable
Dislikes: Nothing notable

[Translated from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/character.html]official website[/url]]

Her full name is Limestone, but people around prefer to call her "Limes".

[spoiler]She looks pretty young at first glance, however, she's only a year younger than Raito.[/spoiler]
